note_zh: 手工设计的合成判别测试，非真实论文，也不是准确率验证集。required 是最低必要标签；额外标签须独立证据。

tests.name: energy_based_not_energy
tests.title: An Energy-Based Model for Image Synthesis
tests.abstract: We introduce a new energy-based probabilistic image model and a learning objective for image synthesis.
tests.reason_zh: 概率 energy 不是电力；一般模型训练也不自动证明预训练。

tests.name: gpu_dependency_not_chip
tests.title: A New Vision Classifier
tests.abstract: We introduce a new visual representation for image classification. All experiments use four NVIDIA A100 GPUs.
tests.reason_zh: 实验平台不构成芯片/系统/能源贡献。

tests.name: sram_hardware
tests.title: Banked SRAM for Neural Accelerators
tests.abstract: We design a new SRAM bank architecture and controller circuit for a neural-network accelerator and evaluate hardware area and bandwidth.
tests.reason_zh: 硬件存储架构不同于 Agent 记忆。

tests.name: memory_io_kernel
tests.title: IO-Aware Attention Execution
tests.abstract: We implement a new tiled exact attention kernel on existing GPUs, reducing transfers between HBM and SRAM without changing model semantics.
tests.reason_zh: 既有硬件上的 kernel，不是芯片研究。

tests.name: agent_memory
tests.title: Episodic Memory for Language Agents
tests.abstract: We build a language-agent memory module that writes reflections after failed tasks and retrieves them on later trials; the LLM weights remain fixed.
tests.reason_zh: 持久经验文本不等于权重更新或存储硬件。

tests.name: kv_paging
tests.title: Paged KV Cache for LLM Serving
tests.abstract: We present a serving runtime that pages KV cache blocks and batches requests to increase throughput on fixed models.
tests.reason_zh: 执行状态分页不是 Agent 语义记忆。

tests.name: generic_attention_not_foundation
tests.title: Attention for Small-Data Vision
tests.abstract: We train a compact attention classifier from scratch on one image-label task and introduce a new attention architecture.
tests.reason_zh: Attention 本身不能证明 foundation model。

tests.name: foundation_positive
tests.title: A General Reusable Language Model
tests.abstract: We pretrain a reusable language model on broad web text and demonstrate adaptation across translation, question answering and summarization.
tests.reason_zh: 广泛预训练、复用和跨任务支持 foundation。

tests.name: marl_not_llm_agents
tests.title: Multi-Agent Policy Gradients
tests.abstract: We prove convergence of a new multi-agent reinforcement-learning algorithm for tabular Markov games. No language model or agent software workflow is introduced.
tests.reason_zh: MARL 学习算法不自动等于 LLM Agent 系统。

tests.name: llm_multiagent
tests.title: A Team Harness for Language Agents
tests.abstract: We build a multi-agent software workflow in which existing LLM agents negotiate roles, exchange messages and coordinate task execution without model retraining.
tests.reason_zh: Agent 系统协作有明确软件组织贡献。

tests.name: tta_not_serving
tests.title: Online Test-Time Adaptation
tests.abstract: We propose an algorithm that updates a vision model from unlabeled target-distribution examples at test time to improve prediction accuracy under shift.
tests.reason_zh: 改变模型以适应分布，不是吞吐服务系统。

tests.name: reasoning_not_serving
tests.title: Inference-Time Search for Reasoning
tests.abstract: We improve mathematical reasoning accuracy using a new search-and-verification strategy that spends additional model calls per question.
tests.reason_zh: 能力导向的 test-time compute 区别于系统执行优化。

tests.name: ai_for_grid
tests.title: Reinforcement Learning for Grid Dispatch
tests.abstract: We apply an existing reinforcement-learning method to electricity-grid dispatch and evaluate outage avoidance; the grid serves ordinary public loads.
tests.reason_zh: 既有 RL 的电网应用；无 AI 供能或新算法贡献。

tests.name: grid_for_ai
tests.title: Electricity Capacity for AI Datacenters
tests.abstract: We study grid expansion and generation capacity required to meet projected AI datacenter electricity demand.
tests.reason_zh: AI 是耗能负载，能源供给为中心。

tests.name: facility_cooling
tests.title: Liquid Cooling for AI Datacenters
tests.abstract: We design and evaluate a datacenter liquid-cooling and internal power-delivery system for AI compute racks.
tests.reason_zh: 按官方层描述，机房冷却及供配电属于 Infrastructure。

tests.name: compression_not_chip
tests.title: ADC-Aware Model Quantization
tests.abstract: We adjust neural-network weights and activations through quantization-aware training to tolerate a fixed analog accelerator; no circuits or devices are changed.
tests.reason_zh: 对已有器件适配的模型方法，不自动算硬件产物。

tests.name: tool_learning_not_harness
tests.title: Learning API Decisions
tests.abstract: We train a language model to choose external APIs and generate arguments using self-supervised demonstrations.
tests.reason_zh: API 决策学习与工具集成平台区分。

tests.name: tools_harness_not_training
tests.title: A Universal Agent Tool Executor
tests.abstract: We introduce a reusable tool execution and environment-connection layer for existing LLM agents, with safe argument validation and no model training.
tests.reason_zh: 模型仅为依赖，贡献为工具执行系统。

tests.name: rag_not_vector_db
tests.title: Learning Retrieval-Augmented Generation
tests.abstract: We jointly train a retriever and generator to use external knowledge for factual answers; the vector database is an unchanged library.
tests.reason_zh: 知识利用机制不同于后端引擎与情节记忆。

tests.name: vector_db_not_rag
tests.title: An AI Vector Retrieval Engine
tests.abstract: We design an index execution engine for AI embedding retrieval that improves latency and memory utilization with no change to the learned retriever.
tests.reason_zh: 系统检索引擎，无模型 RAG 创新。

tests.name: pure_cs_outside
tests.title: A Crash-Consistent Filesystem
tests.abstract: We propose a generic crash-consistency protocol for a filesystem and prove recovery guarantees for ordinary file operations. No AI workload or learning method is involved.
tests.reason_zh: 不能为覆盖全部 CS 造第六层，也不能把一切计算基础设施算 AI。

tests.name: ambiguous_missing_text
tests.title: Real or Not Real
tests.reason_zh: 缺证不同于 outside_scope。

tests.name: agent_eval_without_domain
tests.title: A Benchmark for General Language Agents
tests.abstract: We introduce an interactive benchmark with multiple tool environments and measure end-to-end task completion by language agents across unrelated domains.
tests.reason_zh: 通用 Agent 有独立位置，不要求行业名。

tests.name: carbon_multilayer
tests.title: Carbon-Aware Training Scheduler
tests.abstract: We design a GPU-cluster scheduler that moves AI training jobs across regions based on electricity carbon intensity, and validate both scheduling throughput and lifecycle emissions.
tests.reason_zh: 独立的碳需求管理与调度系统贡献支持跨层，GPU 仍不证明芯片贡献。
